motif_call.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / faithful abstraction. Input image is the APPROVED FINAL REVEAL A-r01 of a sunflower, and is the sole edit target and geometry reference. Create ONE separate simplified 2D motif illustration derived faithfully from this exact image, for a future approximately 32 by 40 cell COLOR nonogram. This is NOT the cell grid and must not look like pixel art. Preserve the image's exact botanical identity, near-frontal round flower in upper half, its position, head-to-stem-to-leaves proportions, gently curved upright stem, two broad heart-shaped leaves, LEFT leaf higher than RIGHT leaf, their attachment positions and angles, the important open spaces between head, leaves and stem, and all visible extremities. Keep the full intended flower crown and both leaves, no clipping. Do not change view or pose. Simplify the complex overlapping gold petal crown into about 16 clearly readable substantial pointed petal forms while preserving its overall contour and large brown center. Replace ALL tiny seed florets, spirals, speckles and dots in the center by ONE calm SOLID brown disk; no seed detail at all. Remove ALL texture, gradients, shading, highlights and tiny leaf serrations. Keep a few broad characteristic leaf tips and only ONE broad central dark-green vein per leaf if it can remain substantial. Use exactly FOUR intentional solid color families: warm golden yellow #e8ae28 for petals; warm dark brown #684323 for flower center and minimal flower boundaries; medium leaf green #638449 for main leaf surfaces; deep forest green #29452e for sturdy stem, petioles and a few structural leaf boundaries. No fifth color, no black, white, ochre, gloss or pale veins. Smooth confident simple clean contours, large connected flat painted regions, warm quiet hand-drawn 2D character. Avoid small isolated decorative marks, narrow shading ribbons and overly intricate outlines. Exterior background AND actual internal spaces must be genuinely transparent alpha, not a drawn checkerboard. No text, grid, numbers, frame, pot, scenery or added objects. This is a simplification of the approved target, never a redesigned sunflower. Output a complete portrait illustration on transparent background with a little breathing room.

original_A_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: final reveal artwork for the Picross hand-drawn collection. Create ONE polished detailed colored 2D illustration of a sunflower, as a standalone individual PNG with a truly transparent background. Warm calm hand-drawn style, clean confident dark brown contours, substantial rich color areas, restrained shading. Golden yellow ray petals, warm dark brown central seed disk with carefully drawn seed patterns, natural green stem and broad heart-shaped serrated leaves with visible veins. Sophisticated illustrated botanical character, not a photo, not 3D, not a flat icon, not pixel art. Fine surface details support the form without visual noise. Preserve a crisp readable silhouette even as a small thumbnail. No text, letters, labels, border, watermark, grid or checkerboard drawn into the image, no container or props, no ground patch, no background rectangle. All exterior negative space and gaps between leaves/stem/petals must be genuine alpha transparency. Center the complete intended subject with modest breathing room, never clipping leaf tips or petals. This is a detailed final reward illustration, not a simplified puzzle source. Composition A: a single upright sunflower plant portrait, large near-frontal round flower head in the upper half, a gently curving sturdy stem continuing down to a clean end, exactly two broad leaves branching to left and right at different heights. Balanced iconic whole-flower silhouette. The flower disk faces the viewer, the petal circle is organically irregular and richly layered with individual curved petal tips; brown center is clearly distinct.
